title: Check five original array contracts through an isolated second opinion
description: Rebuild and pin the historical range-capable Rust consumer once. Use the original 336, 346 and 337 induction entrypoints with and without the opt-in, binding actual classpaths, theorem, dependencies and successful initialization. Check a caller with callee-only evidence, the original extra-write witness, and consumer read restrictions. Charge compilation, preparation, issuing hints, isolation, checking and end-to-end costs.
expected: Four source-bound contracts are independently established and the extra-write caller has a checked counterexample. A valid callee certificate cannot establish its caller. Both dispositions and actual inputs survive every comparison.
